interval_method: 90th percentile absolute calibration residual, symmetric and clipped at zero; empirical, not guaranteed
limitations: Targets are available reported NFIP payment sums, not ultimate or complete losses. Missing components are counted separately, not inferred.
Signed payment adjustments are retained. Negative county totals and entirely missing payment targets are excluded.
Selected storm cohort, not a representative sample of all storms.
Geographic proximity and dates do not prove storm causation.
County internal points miss large county footprints and remote rainfall flooding.
No historical policy exposure denominator; insurance take up and coverage changes are unmodeled.
Claims include zero payment records; counts are matched records, not unique properties.
Current county geography is used retrospectively. NRI is context only, excluded from predictors.
Intervals are empirical and county errors are correlated within storms.
Full observed tracks are used, so this is a retrospective benchmark, not a forecast validation.
